title: DIGIT Pro

frontend.summary: Standard Desk Page /app/digit-pro (department workspaces, section workspaces, finance views) plus scoped app_include CSS/JS and doctype_js form extensions shipped as plain assets inside the package. No separate compiled bundle; the Lovable React screens are the virtual preview and are packed in the source ZIP for review only.

integrations.name: Frappe Insights
integrations.needs: Not required. Dashboards use native Number Cards / Dashboard Charts and the app's own server-aggregated widgets.

integrations.name: ZATCA / KSA VAT / Zakat
integrations.needs: Not available in Core; shown as 'Not available', never as links. Needs an approved official rule pack.

staging_checks: Open /app/digit-pro as Accounts User, Sales User, Purchase User, Stock User and System Manager; each sees only permitted departments and records.
Main Dashboard and the five department overviews load; every KPI drill opens the native list with the same filter and count.
Open a Sales Invoice, Purchase Order and Journal Entry from DIGIT Pro: the context bar appears and the native form saves/submits normally.
Switch the user language to Arabic: the Page and native screens render RTL with Arabic labels.
bench --site <staging-site> uninstall-app digit_pro leaves every ERPNext document untouched.
known_limitations: Never installed on a real Frappe/ERPNext bench; every runtime claim is unverified until the staging checklist is executed (package BLOCKERS.md item 1).
Field names validated against the frozen frappe/erpnext v16-line meta; the exact v16 patch release is not pinned and v15 is incompatible (Asset.net_purchase_amount).
Context on native screens is a DOM context bar inserted by digit_pro.js after router changes, not a documented Desk API.
Widget aggregations cap at 5,000 rows per widget.
Several React preview screens (Finance SC-F-05..14 page routes, Customer 360 panel, some section panels) are not ported to the Desk Page; they are disclosed as not available in the export.
Fonts load from Google Fonts (OFL); air-gapped sites must self-host.
The virtual plugin manifest (0.2.0) and the Frappe package (0.7.0) are independent version lines.
